review_scope: Static inspection only; no product import, reader invocation, native query or workload performed. Named helper/evidence hashes verified; 249 fixture hashes are runtime guards, not recaptured by this review.
outer_checks: Requires both current-source whole/full successes and owned-job cleanup; this is admission evidence, not final acceptance.
Pins current source/input/environment, plan/helpers, prior evidence, fixture bytes, root/whole/full records, both reviews and exact root ACK before and in all-outcome finally.
Exclusive new outputs/log; unchanged owned lifecycle uses declared 180-second diagnostic cap and rejects residual children/cleanup failure.
Primary errors survive secondary guard/report failures; failure stops without automatic retry.
launch_conditions: Both exact prospective acceptance and quality review hashes must be supplied by the root ACK. This report does not invent the quality role disposition.
ACK must be APPROVED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY, pin exact controller/plan, assert owned QA idle and explicitly decline an external-host idle claim.
All pinned bytes must remain unchanged; root invokes at most the declared fixed comparison.
limits: Native reader alone has the pass-through opener observer. Its clock/wrapper perturbation is asymmetric; bookkeeping is a lower bound, not total overhead to subtract.
Both order results and all per-reference observations must be retained; cache warming, repeated references and temporal order preclude claiming historical cold cause from a faster block.
Builtin path.read_bytes is a diagnostic primitive with different Windows sharing/reparse semantics, not a reconstructed release baseline or authorized product replacement.
Native opener subinterval combines native CreateFile and CRT descriptor conversion; the remainder includes Python buffering/read/close and observer effects.
No absolute threshold, release SLO, benchmark sample replacement, source correction, performance equivalence or Master53 closure is approved.
